_doc: Prompts of the puppet Paint step (hdart/puppet_paint.py, Workshop Race tab: the Paint block of each gender row and the Shared prompts card). A paint prompt is the Race tab's style groups + `figure` (or `complete`) with {body} = race traits + description + the gender body text (specs/races.json) + `sexes.<sex>.extra`, and {clothes} = `sexes.<sex>.clothes`. The back adds `back_reference`. `fix` is the Parts editor's AI fix. `face_guide`: faint (default: thin light guide lines and a blank-face prompt, so the painted head stays faceless and its face comes from the Face tab) or marks (solid eye/mouth marks: the head gets its own face).

figure.front: One {body}, {clothes}, full body, three-quarter view facing left, seen slightly from above, standing in an A-pose, arms held out and down away from the body; a blank face: no eyes, no eyebrows, no nose and no mouth drawn, only very faint light guide lines where they will go, on a pure white background.
figure.back: One {body}, {clothes}, full body, seen from behind in a three-quarter back view, seen slightly from above, standing in the same A-pose; the back of the bald head and the ears, on a pure white background.

back_reference: The same character as in the reference image, now seen from behind.

complete.front: A character parts sheet for 2D cutout animation: the separate body parts of one {body}, {clothes}, laid out apart on a pure white background, each part drawn whole with rounded joint ends; complete the hidden ends of every part in the same skin, colours and outline. Every part seen in a three-quarter view facing left, from slightly above.
complete.back: A character parts sheet for 2D cutout animation: the separate body parts of one {body}, {clothes}, laid out apart on a pure white background, each part drawn whole with rounded joint ends; complete the hidden ends of every part in the same skin, colours and outline. Every part seen from behind, in a three-quarter back view, from slightly above.

fix: Part of one {body}, {clothes}. Repaint the marked area so it blends in seamlessly with the same skin, colours, shading and outline.

unisex.clothes: plain grey briefs, bald head, barefoot

male.clothes: plain grey boxer briefs, bald head, barefoot

female.extra: pretty feminine face, big eyes with long eyelashes, thin arched eyebrows, a small nose, pink lips, petite rounded shoulders, slim graceful arms, an hourglass figure
female.clothes: plain grey sports bra and grey briefs, bald head, barefoot
